whos_after_me.midnightconfig.title: Who's After Me
whos_after_me.midnightconfig.enabled.too: Master toggle for the threat HUD. Threat sync continues while hidden.
How threat directions map onto the orbit: Absolute (compass) or Screen-relative (view).
whos_after_me.midnightconfig.detectionRa: Detection radius in blocks (8-128). Read by the server process running the mod.
whos_after_me.midnightconfig.orbitSize.t: Orbit radius as a percentage of the viewport half-dimensions (25-100).
whos_after_me.midnightconfig.indicatorSc: Multiplies arc thickness and triangle size together (0.5-3.0).
whos_after_me.midnightconfig.indicatorOp: Final multiplier on the computed indicator opacity (0.1-1.0).
whos_after_me.midnightconfig.pollInterva: Threat poll cadence in server ticks (1-40). Read by the server process running the mod.
